cases.description: Should trigger: blindspot-pass before unfamiliar work
cases.input: I need to add authentication to our Express API. What am I missing?
cases.expect: Produces a blindspot report with landmines, hidden context, and quality calibration
assertions: Ends with a rewritten request incorporating the findings

cases.description: Should trigger: context-audit for bloated config
cases.input: My CLAUDE.md has grown to 200 lines. Audit it.
cases.expect: Inventories all context layers, finds contradictions, proposes cuts
assertions: Scans all context layers reaching the model
Proposes specific deletions with before/after line counts

cases.description: Should trigger: implementation-notes during a build
cases.input: Start building the user profile module per the plan. Keep notes.
assertions: Creates a running notes file with Deviations, Edge Cases, Questions headings
Logs every deviation from plan with rationale

cases.description: Should trigger: change-quiz after a session
cases.input: What did we actually change in this session? Give me a quiz.
cases.expect: Produces a change report and 5-8 question quiz
assertions: Groups changes by intent, not by file
Quiz targets interaction effects and edge cases, not trivia
Misses get explained with the correct answer

cases.description: Should trigger: reference-hunt from existing code
cases.input: Implement pagination like the admin panel does it.
cases.expect: Reads the reference code, produces semantics summary, reimplements
assertions: Produces a semantics summary before writing code
User confirms the summary before implementation
Maps behaviors from reference to new implementation
